record.body: Signature soundscape indices are designed summaries modeled on real indices: a complexity measure for variability, a diversity measure for spread across bands, and a difference measure comparing designed biophony energy with designed anthrophony energy on a scale from minus one to plus one. The indices are Signature inventions with stated rules, not real ACI, ADI, or NDSI values, and the pair never attributes a Signature score to any real site. Like their models, the designed indices respond to all three Signature layers, so designed results are always reported alongside a designed listening check. The pair computes example index values in arithmetic so any reader can verify them.

demo.code:
TITLE = 'Signature Soundscape Indices: Designed Summaries'
BIO = 60
ANTH = 40
val = (BIO - ANTH) / float(BIO + ANTH)
print('Record: ' + TITLE)
print('Biophony energy: %d' % BIO)
print('Anthrophony energy: %d' % ANTH)
print('NDSI-style difference index: %.2f' % val)
print('Positive means biophony-dominated; negative means anthrophony-dominated.')
demo.expected_output:
Record: Signature Soundscape Indices: Designed Summaries
Biophony energy: 60
Anthrophony energy: 40
NDSI-style difference index: 0.20
Positive means biophony-dominated; negative means anthrophony-dominated.
